ceremony.name: St. Mary's Cathedral
ceremony.details: Join us for an intimate ceremony in this beautiful historic cathedral. The ceremony will begin promptly at 4:00 PM. Please arrive 30 minutes early for seating. Parking is available on-site. Dress code: Formal attire preferred.
ceremony.landmark: Near Ayala Triangle Gardens, Across from Greenbelt Mall

reception.name: The Grand Ballroom at Villa Juanita
reception.details: Celebrate with us at our elegant reception. Cocktail hour begins at 6:30 PM followed by dinner and dancing. Live music and entertainment throughout the evening. Open bar available. Please note: The reception venue is a 15-minute drive from the ceremony location.
reception.landmark: 7/11, Near Flying V Gas Station, Next to Taguig City Hall
reception.parking: Free parking available for all guests
reception.menu: Buffet dinner with vegetarian options available
